additional_info.subject: ID0434006-DC/Si-D/DK- [Y2 / S4 313633828004] Power converter issue in DC CRM:02832000136
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus,
Summary of today's intervention:
Checked all the connections of the TF204
Unconclusive, since in the end it looks like a contactor issue
Even so, we reinserted all the connections to the TF204 to remove it from the equation.
After stress testing, the DC4 is working and only failed 1 out of 10(?) times or more.
For the next time that this problem occurs, we need to measure in the busbar before the contactors QA241-242 to understand which pair is the bad one:
By measuring here, we are excluding those contactors:
If the voltage that we are reading here is the "bad" one, then QA23-24 needs replacement.
If the voltage that we are reading here is OK and we are failing the sessions, then QA241-242 needs replacement.
Remember to be very careful and follow all the procedures to measure the busbar, suggestion is crocodile tips for the multimeter to remove human contact.
I will send this ticket to you, if you require assistance let me know in advance so I can prepare and don't schedule anything.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
